label: What alcohol does to a driver
statement: Alcohol reduces alertness, interferes with judgment, and impairs vision.

label: Alcohol affects people differently
statement: Alcohol affects a person differently at different times, depending on physical and emotional condition, other drugs, and even how much food is in the stomach.

label: Only time sobers you up
statement: Coffee, fresh air, cold showers and exercise do not sober anyone up — time is the only sobering influence.

label: One drink equals one drink
statement: A one-ounce shot of 100-proof whiskey, a six-ounce glass of wine and a 12-ounce can of beer all contain the same amount of alcohol.

label: BAC keeps rising after the last drink
statement: When a person has more than one drink per hour, BAC builds up and keeps rising for hours after the last drink.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Driving Impaired or Under the Influence
source.sourceQuote: When a person has more than one (1) drink per hour, the BAC level builds up in his or her body.

label: Legal drinking age
statement: The legal drinking age in West Virginia is 21.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Driving Impaired or Under the Influence
source.sourceQuote: The legal drinking age in West Virginia is 21 years old.

label: Zero tolerance under 21
statement: If you are under 21 and any measurable amount of alcohol is found in your system, you will lose your driver's license.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)

label: BAC 0.08 presumption
statement: A BAC of 0.08 percent or more means the driver is presumed to be driving under the influence.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)

label: BAC between 0.05 and 0.08
statement: A BAC above 0.05 but below 0.08 percent is relevant evidence to presume the driver's ability to drive is impaired, and a licence can be revoked below 0.08.

label: Implied consent
statement: By driving, you are deemed to have consented to a Breathalyzer if arrested for DUI; refusing revokes your driving privilege for one year up to life.

label: Safety and Treatment Program
statement: Any time a licence is revoked or suspended for DUI, you must complete a prescribed Safety and Treatment program before you can be reinstated.

label: Ignition interlock
statement: The Interlock device attaches to the ignition and prevents an intoxicated person from starting the car; participation is mandatory for two or more DUI revocations within ten years.

statement: Drugs can cause drowsiness, loss of coordination, hallucinations or total body malfunction even when prescribed by a physician or bought over the counter.
